Course Selection
Course
selection for the teacher education
program
is based on Ontario Legislation (Regulation 347/02),
dialogue with the Ontario College of Teachers Accreditation Division, and current
research on effective teacher education practices. Integration among
the individual courses will be actively sought by the course
instructors. All methods courses include common themes related to the
conceptual framework.
